content:
[Intro]
[G5]
Go!

[Pre-Verse]
[G5]

[Verse 1]
[G5]Trust is dead, like
everything else you said
Each word more
meaningless than the next Your
lips and your lies have
severed the ties
I don't deserve this and
you don't deserve
me!

[Verse 2]
[G5]I should've known but I
doubted myself Gave you
every benefit of a doubt,
I wanted no one else!
But I
guess I
wasn't enough
for you!

[Verse 3]
[G5]BLEAGH!
Don't pretend like we
can recover,
when you chose the lust
of another
Where did
I go wrong? I
know I wasn't perfect but I
certainly tried so hard
Was it a moment of weak-
ness, or was it the thrill?
Did you ache for a feel-
ing, that you faked to

[Bridge]
[G5]feel?

[Interlude]
[G5]

[Bridge]
[G5]Bruh!
Don't pretend like we
can recover,
when you chose the lust
of another

[Breakdown]
[G5]
Ah!
I see your wan-
dering eyes and
second glan-
ces
I see,
through your lies,
no second chances!

[Verse 4]
[G5]
Cut me free, you'll
never be what I need
I hope you choke on the
words I was lead to be-
lieve Like a
puppet on your strings;
control means
everything!

[Chorus]
[G5]And in my
heart, I
want to forgive
you That
doesn't mean I'll forget,
you'll
always be my regret!
Oh!
You'll
always be my regret!

[Outro]
[G5]
Here's to a past
I'll never need
No here’s to you
Rest in
peace!
title: The River
tuning: G F A# D# G C
